name: Zombie's Gambit
author: FRO_PWR
summary: Capturing with a king earns a king.
description: An epic king gambit with a simple, greedy rule: every time one of your kings captures, another king drops into your stock (space permitting). Anarchist's Gambit, which counts every piece as a king, turns it into a king factory. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs alongside it.
